sources.quote: HD 96063 is a 8th-magnitude red-giant branch star located about 454 light-years (139 pc) away in the constellation of Leo.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 13 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,007 K, so 4.761 solar radii.
